name: FoldBench
description: An all-atom benchmark for assessing the atomic-level accuracy of biomolecular structure prediction methods against high-resolution reference structures.
evaluation_method: All-atom structural similarity metrics (RMSD, lDDT, TM-score and related atomic-distance based measures)
general_score_metric: all-atom RMSD / lDDT (local distance difference test)
typical_sota_score: variable; many top methods report lDDT in the ~70–90% range for high-quality targets but lower on challenging cases
notes: Compute- and data-intensive; benchmark performance depends on experimental structure resolution and target selection; potential training/test contamination if methods used similar experimental structures; focused on structural biology (non-LLM) and can be sensitive to minor modeling differences (side-chain placement, protonation).
